evidence.expiry: 限セクション『(ヒットなし)』。コンセッション/特許束依存の期限型独占ではないソフトウェア業態→no
evidence.dom: 『a leading enterprise software company』(戦略記述)。ただし戦略リスク『Our market share and profit could decline due to increased competition, market consolidation... loss of market share through traditional, new, and cooperating competitors and hyperscalers』で寡占環境→70(圧倒的だが独占ではない・保守)
evidence.irr: 『RISE with SAP is targeted at our installed base customers and helps them on their journey from legacy ERP systems to SAP Business Suite』→レガシーERPからの移行摩擦=高摩擦移行困難→70
evidence.rep: installed base+『a leading enterprise software company』+『AI-First, Suite-First strategy』(スイート網羅)。数十年構築のERPスイート=極困難→80(hits直接のシェア/構築額数値は乏しく間接根拠・保守)
evidence.dur: 『installed base』RISE/GROW移行プログラム=スイッチングコスト堀→75
evidence.erosion: 『price pressure, cost increases, and loss of market share through traditional, new, and cooperating competitors and hyperscalers』→競争圧力は明記されるがリスクファクター記述で実損失の証拠なし→emerging
evidence.disrupt: ハイパースケーラー/新ビジネスモデルの競争(同上)は未決着だが、SAP自身のクラウド移行は進行中(Cloud and software revenue 88% of total revenue in 2025・Subscription +22%)→unsettled
evidence.moatdecay: 『Subscription revenue increased 22%』『Cloud and software revenue represented 88% of total revenue in 2025(2024:87%)』+installed base移行継続=市場地位拡大→no
evidence.geopol: 『Approximately 67% of our total revenue in 2025(2024:67%) was attributable to non-euro denominated transactions』+地域分散(EMEA46%/Americas39%/APJ14%)+『higher U.S. tariffs and related uncertainty』→中(EU拠点・分散だがFX/関税露出)=1
